slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: items
slots.about: this week's to-dos: id, date, text, done

slots.name: day_names
slots.about: seven day names, Sunday first, in the app's language; the week starts on the phone's first_weekday

slots.name: today_word
slots.about: after today's day name, so today is not told by colour alone

slots.name: week_word
slots.about: after the week's done of total on top

slots.name: nothing_text
slots.about: the faint line under a day with nothing

slots.name: add_word
slots.about: the faint add row under each day

slots.name: add_label
slots.about: label of the text field that opens under a day

slots.name: tick_word
slots.about: spoken before a to-do when not done

slots.name: untick_word
slots.about: spoken before a to-do when done

empty.shows: nothing_text under a day with nothing, and its add row; the header keeps its place

attention.shows: today's header in accent with today_word after the name

fallback.shows: the add row turns into a text field under that day; a blank entry adds nothing

labels.todo: tick_word or untick_word and the text

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: This week only, from first_weekday. A to-do is typed under its day: the add row opens one text field there, and the entry lands on that day.
